i.norm: Verifies that FilterListIterator.hasNext() caches its look-ahead result. When the filter scans the underlying iterator to find the first matching element, it consumes elements from that iterator. A subsequent hasNext() call must return the same cached result without re-scanning, so the filter still reports a next element even after the underlying iterator is fully exhausted.
Build a single-element list whose one element satisfies the predicate
First call: the filter reads ahead through the underlying iterator to locate the matching element, caching it internally and exhausting the underlying iterator
Second call: the filter must serve the result from the cache, not re-scan
The underlying iterator is now exhausted due to the filter's look-ahead
Despite the exhausted underlying iterator, the filter still sees a next element because it cached the matching object during the first hasNext() call
